plan.notes: Official Fitchburg State University 4-Year Plan of Study, B.A. Biology (sheet marked 'Revised 5/26'; recorded against the current 2025-2026 Undergraduate Catalog since the sheet states no catalog year). Seven junior/senior slots are 3-4 credit electives (BIOL >=2000, PHYS elective, BIOL >=3000 capstone); all are transcribed at the 3-credit minimum per the no-guessing rule, so the plan sums to 116 while the sheet requires 120 for graduation — the student makes up the balance by selecting 4-credit electives. The sheet lists 'BIOL 1800' for both General Biology I and II (kept verbatim; allow_repeated_courses set). Sheet notes: MATH >=1300 elective (MATH 1700 Applied Statistics recommended); PHYS elective = PHYS 1100, 2300, or 2600; BIOL 4903 (Independent Study) and BIOL 4950 (Internship) count as Biology electives; minimum 37 BIOL credits; BIOL 3700 Bioethics can double-count as a Biology elective and the ER gen-ed.
